misalignments.reason: The RED selector treats any exhausted-budget outcome as an assertion-failing condition. A deterministic unsuccessful terminal result after budget exhaustion is permitted and required by NFR-7; only indeterminate, non-terminal, or nondeterministic exhaustion handling should fail.

repairs.action: Revise the selector intent so it fails only for indeterminate, non-terminal, or nondeterministic terminal classification, including an exhausted-budget case that does not deterministically terminate unsuccessfully. Preserve deterministic unsuccessful budget exhaustion as a passing outcome.
